negative_findings.description: Both bqk-kos.org and bankassoc-kos.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated WebFetch requests on the two highest-value pointer pages (licensed-institutions hub and KBA members page).
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on https://bqk-kos.org/mbikeqyrja-financiare/institucionet-financiare-te-licencuara-2/?lang=en and on https://www.bankassoc-kos.com/Al/anetaret/. Both domains are heavily indexed by search engines and serve many PDFs, so this is bot defence, not a dead site — treated as a hypothesis, not a verdict.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection pipeline for this cell must use a browser-like client with realistic headers; a naive HTTP fetcher will report Kosovo's two most important pointer sources as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Kosovo insurance-industry association ('Shoqata e Siguruesve të Kosovës') was confirmed to exist as a separate body with its own member/statistics site.
negative_findings.result_summary: sq/en searches returned the Albanian insurers' association (shoqatasiguruesve.al) and the Kosovo Insurance Bureau (BKS, bks-ks.org) instead. BKS appears to be the de facto sector body for Kosovo.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a wasted search loop in later cells and redirects insurance-sector actor discovery to BKS plus the BQK licensed-insurers list.

negative_findings.description: A national open-data portal at open.rks-gov.net publishing ARBK or financial-sector datasets could not be confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search for the portal returned only ARBK's own sites and third-party mirrors (arbk.org, arbk.atlas-studio.eu); no open-data catalogue entry for business-registry or payments data surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bulk, machine-readable access to the actor universe likely has to come from third-party mirrors rather than an official open-data endpoint, which raises verification cost.

negative_findings.description: No standalone public list of payment-system participants (RTGS/interbank clearing members, card acquirers/issuers) was located as a separate BQK register page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-system participant information appears embedded in BQK annual reports and in the general licensed-institutions list rather than in a dedicated participants register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A4 card/ATM/POS work must derive the participant universe from annual-report chapters and the licensed list, not from a single clean register.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) pointer coverage for Kosovo financial registers is thin.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr search surfaced BQK's Serbian legal-framework PDFs and the Serbian Official Gazette version of the banking law, but no sr-language member list, sr register index page, or sr association site specific to Kosovo.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr-language monitoring for this cell will have to rely on document-level Serbian translations of Albanian originals; sr-only sources for Kosovo banking actors may not exist, which should temper expectations for sr coverage targets.

coverage_gaps.description: The Kosovo Banking Association member roster and any statistical bulletin it publishes were not read — the pages returned 403 to automated fetch.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-fetch https://www.bankassoc-kos.com/Al/anetaret/ and the publications section with a headless browser and realistic UA; extract the member list into the actor map before other cells run.

coverage_gaps.description: E-money institutions and payment institutions (IPE/IP) were confirmed to be a regulated category with their own BQK regulations, but no dedicated per-category register page was isolated — only the combined dated list PDF.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the IP/IPE section from the 22.04.2026 'Lista e institucioneve financiare' PDF and diff against earlier editions to build a licensing timeline for Kosovo PSPs.

coverage_gaps.description: No Serbian-language association or register index specific to Kosovo banking was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check whether banks operating in Serb-majority municipalities are indexed by NBS or by local Serbian-language business media, and record the outcome explicitly rather than leaving sr coverage silent.

coverage_gaps.description: No Kosovo-specific pointer for card schemes/processors (Visa/Mastercard licensees, local processors, ATM network operators) was identified in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sq terms 'procesimi i kartelave', 'operatori i rrjetit ATM', 'pranimi i kartelave' and cross-reference STIKK members and ARBK activity codes for processing companies.

coverage_gaps.description: Terms of service and rate limits for the third-party ARBK mirrors (arbk.org, arbk.atlas-studio.eu) were not reviewed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read each mirror's ToS/robots.txt before any bulk export; fall back to targeted lookups against the official ARBK registry if bulk use is disallowed.

brief: Kosovo's actor universe for banking and payments is anchored by three pointer families: the BQK licensing register (a hub page plus dated 'Lista e institucioneve financiare' PDFs that name every bank, MFI, NBFI, FX bureau, payment and e-money institution and insurer), the industry associations (Kosovo Banking Association for banks, AMIK for microfinance, BKS for insurance, STIKK for the ICT/fintech vendor layer), and ARBK, the sole official business registry, reachable in bulk mainly through third-party mirrors. Both top-value domains (bqk-kos.org and bankassoc-kos.com) returned 403 to automated fetching while remaining heavily indexed, so collection for this cell must be browser-based rather than plain HTTP. Card/ATM/POS series exist but are embedded in BQK annual and financial-stability reports rather than in a standalone payment-participants register, and Serbian-language coverage is limited to document-level translations of Albanian originals.
